quirks: inputSchema is null in the registry but the endpoint REQUIRES an ?email=<address> query parameter; without it the call would fail
Input is passed as a URL query param, not a JSON body (it is a GET)
Read body.data.status (valid/invalid/accept_all/etc) and body.data.score (0-100); body.data.result is present but deprecated per the response's own _deprecation_notice
usage.guide: Verify an email address's deliverability by calling GET https://x402.orth.sh/hunter/v2/email-verifier with the email passed as a query parameter (?email=someone@domain.com). It is x402-paid (~$0.01 USDC on Base), no API key and no request body. The response is synchronous JSON: read body.data.status ("valid"/"invalid"/etc.) and body.data.score (0-100 confidence) to judge deliverability, plus body.data.mx_records / smtp_check / disposable / webmail for detail. Do NOT rely on body.data.result — it is deprecated in favor of status.
